title: Phone app and Mac Focus Mode notice when updates are stale and send their own status update request before showing them

fields.why: TJ 14 Nov: 'the phone app (and the mac focus mode) should also recognize that we havent gotten an update in a while, so before showing me updates, [it] should also submit its own status update request to make sure things are updated'

text: Status update = 'Status update: every project...' sent with fresh:true (bridge.mjs, lib.mjs deliverToAssistant/isStatusRequest; AppModel.startAssistantFresh). Pick a staleness threshold (genlock ask user if unclear), no repeat while one is in flight, show held items 'as of' until the reply. Read goal next 12's 'As of' work first. Do NOT build/install/push Android; report PHONE-READY. Android files and Focus.kt are claimed by other sessions: check genlock claims.
